capabilities: Convert \( \) and \[ \] delimiters to $ and $$ across a file
Limit conversion to a selected section of a note
Run conversion from the command palette or a toolbar icon
Assign a hotkey to the conversion command
extras: The README warns that the regex-based replacement changes every \(, \), \[ and \] in the file and may cause unexpected results. Installation is manual via the release page.
problem: Math formulas generated by GPT and other AI tools use \( \) and \[ \] delimiters, which Obsidian does not render.
summary: Converts LaTeX math delimiters \( \) and \[ \] to Markdown-style $ and $$ so AI-generated formulas render in Obsidian.
